So here's what I'd work on: **in the opening, prioritize the center before automatic development.** Before each opening move, ask yourself two quick questions — "Is there a capture that clarifies things?" and "Can I claim the center right now?" If yes, seriously consider it before moving a bishop or knight to its "natural" square. Do that, and games like this one will start tilting your way.

Second, train yourself to spot and take **safe material** — when a clean capture like Nxe5 is on the table, verify it works and grab it rather than looking for something more exciting. Do those two things and your average centipawn loss will drop noticeably.

Keep it up — one disciplined moment away from a very clean game.
